title: FORMAT(value, format) for the named and common custom formats and every Acme format string (en-US)

cases.query: EVALUATE ROW("v", FORMAT(DATE(2025, 3, 7) + TIME(14, 5, 9), "mmmm d, yyyy"))
EVALUATE ROW("v", FORMAT([Avg Pages per Session], "0.0"))
EVALUATE ROW("v", FORMAT([Products Never Sold Count], "0"))
